confirm.reprocess:
Re-run matching and import for this torrent?

MediaFlow will remove baseline, clear Failed / NeedsReview / Ignored and release Imported state if the Jellyfin file is missing or is no longer the same hardlink. Healthy Imported entries are preserved.
confirm.deleteJellyfin:
Delete MediaFlow files for “{name}” from the Jellyfin library?

qBittorrent and source files remain. MediaFlow temporarily baselines the torrent to prevent immediate re-import. Use Reprocess to restore it.
confirm.deleteQb:
Delete “{name}” from qBittorrent?

Downloaded source files remain on disk. Jellyfin is unchanged.
confirm.deleteQbFiles:
WARNING: delete “{name}” from qBittorrent AND delete the torrent source files?

Existing Jellyfin hardlinks remain. This cannot be undone for the source data.
confirm.reset:
Delete all MediaFlow state for “{name}”?

Jellyfin and qBittorrent files are not deleted. The worker can process the torrent again.
confirm.approve: Choose TMDb #{id} and import the file?
confirm.ignore: Ignore this file? The worker will not process it again until Retry is used in History.
confirm.clearLogs: Clear the structured MediaFlow log? Import-state history will not be deleted.
toast.stateRetry: State reset; the file can be processed again.
